record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, <FI>A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>, the servant<WH05650> of the LORD<WH03068>, who spake<WH01696><WTH8765> unto the LORD<WH03068> the words<WH01697> of this song<WH07892> in the day<WH03117> <FI>that<Fi>  the LORD<WH03068> delivered<WH05337><WTH8689> him from the hand<WH03709> of all his enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, and from the hand<WH03027> of Saul<WH07586>: And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>,<Fo><Fo> I will love<WH07355><WTH8799> thee, O LORD<WH03068>, my strength<WH02391>.

The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> my rock<WH05553>, and my fortress<WH04686>, and my deliverer<WH06403><WTH8764>; my God<WH0410>, my strength<WH06697>, in whom I will trust<WH02620><WTH8799>; my buckler<WH04043>, and the horn<WH07161> of my salvation<WH03468>, <FI>and<Fi> my high tower<WH04869>. <RF>my strength: Heb. my rock<Rf>
I will call<WH07121><WTH8799> upon the LORD<WH03068>, <FI>who is worthy<Fi> to be praised<WH01984><WTH8794>: so shall I be saved<WH03467><WTH8735> from mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>.
The sorrows<WH02256> of death<WH04194> compassed<WH0661><WTH8804> me, and the floods<WH05158> of ungodly men<WH01100> made me afraid<WH01204><WTH8762>. <RF>ungodly men: Heb. Belial<Rf>
The sorrows<WH02256> of hell<WH07585> compassed me about<WH05437><WTH8804>: the snares<WH04170> of death<WH04194> prevented<WH06923><WTH8765> me. <RF>sorrows: or, cords<Rf>

In my distress<WH06862> I called<WH07121><WTH8799> upon the LORD<WH03068>, and cried<WH07768><WTH8762> unto my God<WH0430>: he heard<WH08085><WTH8799> my voice<WH06963> out of his temple<WH01964>, and my cry<WH07775> came<WH0935><WTH8799> before<WH06440> him, <FI>even<Fi> into his ears<WH0241>.

Then the earth<WH0776> shook<WH01607><WTH8799> and trembled<WH07493><WTH8799>; the foundations<WH04146> also of the hills<WH02022> moved<WH07264><WTH8799> and were shaken<WH01607><WTH8691>, because he was wroth<WH02734><WTH8804>.

There went up<WH05927><WTH8804> a smoke<WH06227> out of his nostrils<WH0639>, and fire<WH0784> out of his mouth<WH06310> devoured<WH0398><WTH8799>: coals<WH01513> were kindled<WH01197><WTH8804> by it. <RF>out of his nostrils: Heb. by his, etc<Rf>
He bowed<WH05186><WTH8799> the heavens<WH08064> also, and came down<WH03381><WTH8799>: and darkness<WH06205> <FI>was<Fi> under his feet<WH07272>.
And he rode<WH07392><WTH8799> upon a cherub<WH03742>, and did fly<WH05774><WTH8799>: yea, he did fly<WH01675><WTH8799> upon the wings<WH03671> of the wind<WH07307>.

He made<WH07896><WTH8799> darkness<WH02822> his secret place<WH05643>; his pavilion<WH05521> round about<WH05439> him <FI>were<Fi> dark<WH02824> waters<WH04325> <FI>and<Fi> thick clouds<WH05645> of the skies<WH07834>.
At the brightness<WH05051> <FI>that was<Fi> before him his thick clouds<WH05645> passed<WH05674><WTH8804>, hail<WH01259> <FI>stones<Fi> and coals<WH01513> of fire<WH0784>.

The LORD<WH03068> also thundered<WH07481><WTH8686> in the heavens<WH08064>, and the Highest<WH05945> gave<WH05414><WTH8799> his voice<WH06963>; hail<WH01259> <FI>stones<Fi> and coals<WH01513> of fire<WH0784>.
Yea, he sent out<WH07971><WTH8799> his arrows<WH02671>, and scattered<WH06327><WTH8686> them; and he shot out<WH07232><WTH8804> lightnings<WH01300>, and discomfited<WH02000><WTH8799> them.

Then the channels<WH0650> of waters<WH04325> were seen<WH07200><WTH8735>, and the foundations<WH04146> of the world<WH08398> were discovered<WH01540><WTH8735> at thy rebuke<WH01606>, O LORD<WH03068>, at the blast<WH05397> of the breath<WH07307> of thy nostrils<WH0639>.
He sent<WH07971><WTH8799> from above<WH04791>, he took<WH03947><WTH8799> me, he drew<WH04871><WTH8686> me out of many<WH07227> waters<WH04325>. <RF>many: or, great<Rf>
He delivered<WH05337><WTH8686> me from my strong<WH05794> enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>, and from them which hated<WH08130><WTH8802> me: for they were too strong<WH0553><WTH8804> for me.
They prevented<WH06923><WTH8762> me in the day<WH03117> of my calamity<WH0343>: but the LORD<WH03068> was my stay<WH04937>.
He brought me forth<WH03318><WTH8686> also into a large place<WH04800>; he delivered<WH02502><WTH8762> me, because he delighted<WH02654><WTH8804> in me.<CM>
The LORD<WH03068> rewarded<WH01580><WTH8799> me according to my righteousness<WH06664>; according to the cleanness<WH01252> of my hands<WH03027> hath he recompensed<WH07725><WTH8686> me.
For I have kept<WH08104><WTH8804> the ways<WH01870> of the LORD<WH03068>, and have not wickedly departed<WH07561><WTH8804> from my God<WH0430>.
For all his judgments<WH04941> <FI>were<Fi> before me, and I did not put away<WH05493><WTH8686> his statutes<WH02708> from me.
I was also upright<WH08549> before him, and I kept<WH08104><WTH8691> myself from mine iniquity<WH05771>. <RF>before: Heb. with<Rf>

Therefore hath the LORD<WH03068> recompensed<WH07725><WTH8686> me according to my righteousness<WH06664>, according to the cleanness<WH01252> of my hands<WH03027> in his eyesight<WH05869>. <RF>in...: Heb. before his eyes<Rf>
With the merciful<WH02623> thou wilt shew thyself merciful<WH02616><WTH8691>; with an upright<WH08549> man<WH01399> thou wilt shew thyself upright<WH08552><WTH8691>;

With the pure<WH01305><WTH8737> thou wilt shew thyself pure<WH01305><WTH8691>; and with the froward<WH06141> thou wilt shew thyself froward<WH06617><WTH8691>. <RF>shew thyself froward: or, wrestle<Rf>
For thou wilt save<WH03467><WTH8686> the afflicted<WH06041> people<WH05971>; but wilt bring down<WH08213><WTH8686> high<WH07311><WTH8802> looks<WH05869>.
For thou wilt light<WH0215><WTH8686> my candle<WH05216>: the LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430> will enlighten<WH05050><WTH8686> my darkness<WH02822>. <RF>candle: or, lamp<Rf><CM>
For by thee I have run through<WH07323><WTH8799> a troop<WH01416>; and by my God<WH0430> have I leaped over<WH01801><WTH8762> a wall<WH07791>. <RF>run...: or, broken<Rf>

<FI> As for<Fi> God<WH0410>, his way<WH01870> <FI>is<Fi> perfect<WH08549>: the word<WH0565> of the LORD<WH03068> is tried<WH06884><WTH8803>: he <FI>is<Fi> a buckler<WH04043> to all those that trust<WH02620><WTH8802> in him. <RF>tried: or, refined<Rf>
For who <FI>is<Fi> God<WH0433> save<WH01107> the LORD<WH03068>? or who <FI>is<Fi> a rock<WH06697> save<WH02108> our God<WH0430>?
<FI> It is<Fi> God<WH0410> that girdeth<WH0247><WTH8764> me with strength<WH02428>, and maketh<WH05414><WTH8799> my way<WH01870> perfect<WH08549>.
He maketh<WH07737><WTH8764> my feet<WH07272> like hinds<WH0355>' <FI>feet<Fi> , and setteth<WH05975><WTH8686> me upon my high places<WH01116>.
He teacheth<WH03925><WTH8764> my hands<WH03027> to war<WH04421>, so that a bow<WH07198> of steel<WH05154> is broken<WH05181><WTH8765> by mine arms<WH02220>.

Thou hast also given<WH05414><WTH8799> me the shield<WH04043> of thy salvation<WH03468>: and thy right hand<WH03225> hath holden me up<WH05582><WTH8799>, and thy gentleness<WH06037> hath made me great<WH07235><WTH8686>. <RF>thy gentleness...: or, with thy meekness thou hast multiplied me<Rf>
Thou hast enlarged<WH07337><WTH8686> my steps<WH06806> under me, that my feet<WH07166> did not slip<WH04571><WTH8804>. <RF>my feet: Heb. mine ankles<Rf>
I have pursued<WH07291><WTH8799> mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, and overtaken<WH05381><WTH8686> them: neither did I turn again<WH07725><WTH8799> till they were consumed<WH03615><WTH8763>.
I have wounded<WH04272><WTH8799> them that they were not able<WH03201><WTH8799> to rise<WH06965><WTH8800>: they are fallen<WH05307><WTH8799> under my feet<WH07272>.

For thou hast girded<WH0247><WTH8762> me with strength<WH02428> unto the battle<WH04421>: thou hast subdued<WH03766><WTH8686> under me those that rose up<WH06965><WTH8801> against me. <RF>subdued: Heb. caused to bow<Rf>
Thou hast also given<WH05414><WTH8804> me the necks<WH06203> of mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>; that I might destroy<WH06789><WTH8686> them that hate<WH08130><WTH8764> me.
They cried<WH07768><WTH8762>, but <FI>there was<Fi> none to save<WH03467><WTH8688> <FI>them: even<Fi> unto the LORD<WH03068>, but he answered<WH06030><WTH8804> them not.
Then did I beat<WH07833><WTH8799> them small as the dust<WH06083> before<WH06440> the wind<WH07307>: I did cast them out<WH07324><WTH8686> as the dirt<WH02916> in the streets<WH02351>.

Thou hast delivered<WH06403><WTH8762> me from the strivings<WH07379> of the people<WH05971>; <FI>and<Fi> thou hast made<WH07760><WTH8799> me the head<WH07218> of the heathen<WH01471>: a people<WH05971> <FI>whom<Fi> I have not known<WH03045><WTH8804> shall serve<WH05647><WTH8799> me.

As soon as they hear<WH08088><WH0241> of me, they shall obey<WH08085><WTH8735> me: the strangers<WH01121><WH05236> shall submit<WH03584><WTH8762> themselves unto me. <RF>As soon...: Heb. At the hearing of the ear<Rf> <RF>submit...: or, yield feigned obedience<Rf> <RF>strangers: Heb. sons of the stranger<Rf>
The strangers<WH01121><WH05236> shall fade away<WH05034><WTH8799>, and be afraid<WH02727><WTH8799> out of their close places<WH04526>. <RF>strangers: Heb. sons of the stranger<Rf>
The LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>; and blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi> my rock<WH06697>; and let the God<WH0430> of my salvation<WH03468> be exalted<WH07311><WTH8799>.

<FI> It is<Fi> God<WH0410> that avengeth<WH05414><WTH8802><WH05360> me, and subdueth<WH01696><WTH8686> the people<WH05971> under me. <RF>avengeth: Heb. giveth avengements for<Rf> <RF>subdueth: or, destroyeth<Rf>

He delivereth<WH06403><WTH8764> me from mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>: yea, thou liftest me up<WH07311><WTH8787> above those that rise up<WH06965><WTH8801> against me: thou hast delivered<WH05337><WTH8686> me from the violent<WH02555> man<WH0376>. <RF>violent...: Heb. man of violence<Rf>
Therefore will I give thanks<WH03034><WTH8686> unto thee, O LORD<WH03068>, among the heathen<WH01471>, and sing praises<WH02167><WTH8762> unto thy name<WH08034>. <RF>give...: or, confess<Rf>

Great<WH01431><WTH8688> deliverance<WH03444> giveth he to his king<WH04428>; and sheweth<WH06213><WTH8802> mercy<WH02617> to his anointed<WH04899>, to David<WH01732>, and to his seed<WH02233> for<WH05704> evermore<WH05769>.<CM>
